text_to_speech: might want to grab a beverage this is going to be a longer one Dylan Mulvaney just addressed all the Bud Light backlash I've been offline for a few weeks and a lot has been said about me some of which is so far from my truth that I was like hearing my name and I didn't even know who they were talking about sometimes the trans influencer said she felt like she was having Deja Vu from childhood I'm an adult I'm 26. and throughout childhood I was called too feminine and over the top and here I am now being called all those same things but this time it's from other adults she also spoke about her conservative upbringing what I'm struggling with most is that I grew up in a conservative family and I'm extremely privileged because they still love me very much and I grew up in the church and I still have my faith which I am really trying to hold on to right now she ended the video by saying going forward she hopes to share parts of herself that don't have to do with her identity there's clearly no way of winning over everyone

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: I might want to grab a beverage, this is going to be a longer one.
Dylan Mulvaney just addressed all the Bud Light backlash.
I've been offline for a few weeks, and a lot has been said about me.
Some of which is so far from my truth that I was like hearing my name,
and I didn't even know who they were talking about sometimes.
The trans influencer said she felt like she was having deja vu from childhood.
I'm an adult, I'm 26, and throughout childhood I was called two feminine and over the top.
And here I am now being called all those same things, but this time it's from other adults.
She also spoke about her conservative upbringing.
What I'm struggling with most is that I grew up in a conservative family,
and I'm extremely privileged because they still love me very much,
and I grew up in the church, and I still have my faith,
which I am really trying to hold on to right now.
She ended the video by saying going forward,
she hopes to share parts of herself that don't have to do with her identity.
There's clearly no way of winning over everyone.
